source.title: Named official road restrictions
source.cadence: Project/current-status pages; event-driven updates, fixed cadence not stated

source.coverage: Six named road restrictions only; absence is Unknown, never open
source.affectsSimulation: A full closure alters a matching edge only for an explicitly overlapping referenceDate. Vehicle-class restrictions remain context-only until their share of scenario-unit capacity is calibrated.

restriction.scope: Papendrechtsebrug closed to all road traffic in both directions; published diversions add approximately 30–60 minutes
restriction.note: The temporary Baanhoek emergency route and cyclist/pedestrian ferries are not represented as capacity-bearing alternatives; their capacity remains Unknown. Planning can change.

restriction.scope: Merwedebrug closed in both directions to trucks and touring coaches; passenger cars, scheduled buses and emergency services remain allowed
restriction.note: The publisher gives no machine-readable vehicle share, throughput loss or end date. The evidence interval therefore stops at retrieval day; it is visible but has no invented numeric route-capacity effect, and no later date is extrapolated.

restriction.scope: Algerabrug closed to ordinary motor traffic from 10 August 2026 00:00 through 7 September 2026 05:00; emergency services use a controlled lane, while active modes and Waterbus are separate alternatives
restriction.publisher: Rijkswaterstaat / Gemeente Krimpen aan den IJssel
restriction.note: The exercise reference field is date-only and cannot resolve the 05:00 end on 7 September. The restriction is therefore context-only for every matched day and never deletes the generalized edge. Published ordinary-motor, controlled-emergency, active-mode, Waterbus and high-shipping states remain distinct; no public vehicle mix or alternative throughput justifies a numeric effect, and state after expiry is Unknown rather than guaranteed open.

detours: direction-specific Baanderij access via the Praxis car park from Rietschans
restriction.scope: Lage Rijndijk between Sumatrastraat and Spanjaardsbrug closed to cars and buses from 17 August through 11 September 2026; emergency services, cycles and mopeds can pass, with direction-specific Baanderij access
restriction.note: The notice gives calendar dates and role-specific access but no machine-readable direction geometry, traffic mix, detour throughput or emergency priority capacity. The local crossing is therefore visible context only and excluded from causal transfers; missing post-expiry or live state remains Unknown rather than guaranteed open.

unaffectedVehicleClasses: passenger cars and other permitted traffic
detours: Weert to Kelpen-Oler or Roermond via A2/A73
restriction.scope: Heavy vehicle restriction on the N280 Kelperbrug over Kanaal Wessem-Nederweert from 9 June 2026 because corrosion reduced structural capacity; scheduled public transport and emergency services are exempt
restriction.note: The authority notice gives no end date or machine-readable vehicle mix. The evidence interval stops at the 3 September audit retrieval; no later state is extrapolated. It remains context-only and does not invent a numeric route-capacity effect, while an empty NDW match or later absence remains Unknown rather than proof the bridge is open.

restriction.scope: Rijndijk between Zahnstraat/Scherpekamp in Angeren and Krakkedel in Doornenburg closed from 24 August through 2 October 2026 for construction of the ViA15 work-road crossing
restriction.note: The notice supplies dates, endpoints and the N838 detour but does not publish machine-readable direction geometry, modal/emergency exemptions, queue or detour throughput. The internal corridor is visible context only and excluded from causal transfers; empty NDW remains Unknown rather than proof the road is open.
